item.text: {"answer":"The four AI RMF Core functions are GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE.\n\nThe Generative AI Profile identifies twelve risks unique to or exacerbated by generative AI: (1) CBRN Information or Capabilities (chemical, biological, radiological, or nuclear); (2) Confabulation; (3) Dangerous, Violent, or Hateful Content; (4) Data Privacy; (5) Environmental Impacts; (6) Harmful Bias and Homogenization; (7) Human-AI Configuration; (8) Information Integrity; (9) Information Security; (10) Intellectual Property; (11) Obscene, Degrading, and/or Abusive Content; and (12) Value Chain and Component Integration.","citations":["markdown://doc-002/doc-002-nist-ai-rmf-1-0.md#L422-L422","markdown://doc-010/doc-010-nist-ai-600-1-generative-ai-profile.md#L133-L133","markdown://doc-010/doc-010-nist-ai-600-1-generative-ai-profile.md#L139-L139","markdown://doc-010/doc-010-nist-ai-600-1-generative-ai-profile.md#L147-L147","markdown://doc-010/doc-010-nist-ai-600-1-generative-ai-profile.md#L756-L764"],"confidence":0.99}
